# zxing-wasm 3.1.4 (reader only)

Barcode decoder used by the barcode-scanning feature (v1.15.0). Copied unmodified from the npm package
`zxing-wasm@3.1.4` (`dist/iife/reader/index.js` → `zxing-reader.js`, `dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm`).
Self-hosted so the page does not depend on a CDN.
